material_read: The material reads as a high-quality, matte technical ceramic with a precise, engineered finish. It exhibits a clean porcelain-white color and an ultra-controlled eggshell microtexture, conveying a dry and dense feel.
summary: The white ceramic material successfully achieves the desired matte, dense, and engineered technical ceramic aesthetic. It presents a clean porcelain-white color and an ultra-controlled eggshell microtexture, effectively avoiding any resemblance to undesirable materials like plaster or plastic. The commercial material readability is immediate and strong.
